entries.1ee41b51df057a44: Consolidated subsidiary Kō no Kuni Mokuzai Kōgyō Co., Ltd. processes and sells lumber, supplying wood mainly to detached housebuilders and others in Kumamoto Prefecture. Its strength is that it can handle everything from purchasing wood to processing and sales in-house.
entries.2a6259521752ebff: Kō no Kuni Mokuzai Kōgyō Business
entries.2e41592d587dbeff: For housebuilders and local builders, it provides “My Home Robo (Maihōmu Robo),” a SaaS-type home plan search service using generative AI. It also runs an IP licensing business for the brand “niko and ... EDIT HOUSE,” created under a business alliance with Adastria Co., Ltd.
entries.617199193032016c: A consolidated subsidiary of the company (100.0% voting rights ownership), headquartered in Yamaga City, Kumamoto Prefecture, that processes and sells lumber. Relationship details include purchases of materials and concurrent directorships.
entries.62228c5ae2cf52e6: Kō no Kuni Mokuzai Kōgyō Co., Ltd.
entries.769a8bbc28c44ca8: Consolidated subsidiary Ribu Sābisu Co., Ltd. provides an IP licensing service in partnership with other companies' corporate brands, for housebuilders and local builders nationwide. Member businesses can set prices freely and take orders and build.
entries.7d8af424b619ff4f: A consolidated subsidiary of the company, headquartered in Yamaga City, Kumamoto Prefecture, which provides IP licensing services.
entries.85f6ed3e432f039a: It plans, designs, builds and supervises custom-built homes under its own brands (NEOTELLA, Nordi, Finole, etc.) and collaboration brands with other companies. Sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥10,289 million.
entries.bf7d02450b412334: It develops and sells the 3D-printed house “Lib Earth House,” whose main material is soil. In January 2024, it released a 15 m² single-story house, modelA, and in July 2025, it released a single-story house of approximately 100 m², modelB.
entries.e78a324a495866ae: It sells ready-built homes and land. Sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥4,177 million.
entries.ecabcace6746f574: The company attracts customers through digital marketing, including the land search site “e-Tochi net” and a YouTube channel with more than 150,000 subscribers, and provides construction contracts for custom-built homes and sells ready-built homes and land. Sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥10,289 million for the construction contract business and ¥4,177 million for the real estate sales business.
entries.f9d5f22480aadb9f: Headquartered in Yamaga, Kumamoto Prefecture, its main businesses are contract construction of detached houses and real estate sales, with customers attracted through digital marketing, and it also handles services for housing companies and 3D-printed houses.
